speech.heard: In Chad, 96.8% of working women are self-employed. In Qatar, it is 1.2%. Chad leads all nations, running entirely on its own account. Qatar sits at the bottom with 1.2%. Chad hits 25 times the USA, which rests at 3.8%. India hits 78.8% and China hits 35.4%. The lowest include Denmark at 5.7%, Russia at 5.6%, UAE at 5.2% and USA at 3.8%. What is the female self-employment rate where you live?
